subject: Commercial & billing approach for Aurora Labs VPC deployment
messages:
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@auroralabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <dcho@auroralabs.com>
Subject: Commercial model and billing cadence for VPC deployment

Hi David,

Thanks for the product walkthrough yesterday. We are excited about the VPC option but need to align procurement and finance on commercial mechanics before proceeding. A few asks from our side: 

- Can you outline how the platform fee is invoiced and whether Redwood will amortize that fee for accounting purposes?
- Aurora prefers staggered billing where large platform fees are split over time; is that supported?
- We need a clear mapping of support tiers to response SLAs and on-call costs.
- Please attach your SOC 2 attestation and any evidence we can include in our compliance packet.

I attached our RFP and procurement questionnaire. Ideally we would see a 2-year pricing option with a multi-year discount and a one-time migration credit to help cover our on-prem integration work.

Can you send a commercial proposal by COB Wednesday PT?

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Procurement
Aurora Labs
Attachments: Aurora_RFP.xlsx, procurement_questionnaire.pdf

Date: 2026-10-13T08:47:00-07:00
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@auroralabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Commercial model and billing cadence for VPC deployment

Hi Sofia,

Appreciate the clear asks and the RFP. Attached is an initial commercial package tailored to Aurora (pricing_sheet_vpc_Aurora.xlsx). High level options included:

Option A (2-year committed):
- Platform fee amortized over 24 months for billing clarity; Redwood invoices platform fee as three installments by default (50% upfront, 25% @6mo, 25% @12mo) but we can adjust schedule.
- Dedicated support tier: Silver/Gold/Platinum with defined response times and included on-call credits.
- 15% multi-year discount on metered usage with a 24-month commit and a 6-week migration credit for our integration services.

Option B (annual/flexible):
- Higher platform fee, billed upfront; 8% discount on usage for a 12-month commit.
- Support addons charged monthly.

We can provide the SOC2 attestation and current security pack; I have attached SOC2_Attestation.pdf.

If Aurora needs a staggered or custom invoice schedule (for example, 18-month amortization), we can propose that contractually as an addendum and reflect it in the SOW and invoice schedule.

Next steps: if you like Option A, we can prep a redlineable SOW and a DocuSign envelope for signature. If you want a different invoice cadence, tell me the preferred splits and we'll model impact on cashflow and unit price.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182
Attachments: pricing_sheet_vpc_Aurora.xlsx, SOC2_Attestation.pdf

Date: 2026-10-14T10:02:00-07:00
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Subject: Internal: Aurora commercial feedback

David / Priyom,

Couple of quick notes before we go too deep with custom invoicing:

- Risk: longer amortization of the platform fee increases receivable exposure. If Aurora wants 18+ month amortization we should either secure a non-cancellable commit or take the platform fee upfront and issue a credit schedule.
- Discount trade: 15% on usage is aggressive unless they commit to a minimum annual spend. Consider 12% on a 24-month commit, plus a $30k migration credit that can be amortized against the first three invoices.
- Support: recommend Gold as default and add a named escalation engineer in the contract. That reduces operational risk and gives procurement clarity.

I can draft suggested redlines for the SOW and the billing addendum.

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-15T07:31:00-07:00
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@auroralabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <dcho@auroralabs.com>, procurement@auroralabs.com
Subject: Re: Commercial model and billing cadence for VPC deployment

David,

Thanks for the proposal and the SOC2 packet. After internal review Aurora can accept a multi-year commit but with the following counterpoints:

- We prefer platform fee amortization over 18 months to align with our internal capital schedule.
- Request a 12% discount on metered spend for a 24-month commitment rather than 15% on usage; we will extend the commit to 36 months for a 15% discount if Redwood can provide a 6-month migration credit instead of 6-week.
- For invoicing cadence: Aurora would like the platform fee split into three equal installments (upfront, month 6, month 12) and then usage invoiced monthly. Can you confirm whether your billing team can issue invoices to our EU entity (Aurora Labs EU B.V.)?

We have attached the RFP and highlighted procurement constraints. If you can get a redlined SOW & billing addendum by Friday we can route to finance for fast-track approval.

Best,
Sofia
Attachments: Aurora_RFP.xlsx

Date: 2026-10-16T09:05:00-07:00
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@auroralabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Commercial model and billing cadence for VPC deployment

Hi Sofia,

Appreciate the clarity. We can accommodate most of Aurora's asks with the following convergent offer: 

- Discount: 12% on metered usage with a 24-month commitment. Alternative: 15% only if Aurora signs a 36-month commitment and accepts a 6-month migration credit.
- Platform fee amortization: we will amortize over 18 months per your request. For accounting clarity, Redwood will issue three equal platform-fee invoices (Month 0, Month 6, Month 12).
- Migration credit: we can provide a one-time migration credit totalling $45,000 if Aurora commits to 24 months; if they push to 36 months we will increase the credit to $75,000. Credits apply to the first three usage invoices.
- Support: Gold tier included; Platinum optional with 24/7 on-call and 1-hour P1 response as an add-on.

I have prepared a redlined SOW and billing addendum and created a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/0x9a7b-aurora-sow. The SOW references the invoice schedule and includes an exit-cap on platform fee refunds in the event of early termination.

If these terms look good I will route the SOW to your procurement contact and finance for signature.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_Aurora_v2.docx

Date: 2026-10-18T11:22:00-07:00
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@auroralabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <dcho@auroralabs.com>, procurement@auroralabs.com
Subject: Re: Commercial model and billing cadence for VPC deployment

David,

Accepted in principle. Procurement has signed off on the 24-month commitment with the 12% usage discount and the $45,000 migration credit. We also accept the 18-month amortization with the three equal platform-fee invoices. A few final operational asks:

- Please route invoices to Aurora Labs EU B.V. (VAT ID: NL123456789B01).
- Include the named escalation engineer contact in the SOW and confirm the Platinum on-call add-on pricing as an hourly rate in the invoice addendum.
- Send the DocuSign envelope back with the redlines applied; procurement will countersign and return.

We are ready to proceed once the SOW reflects the invoice entity and the migration credit application.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to moving to onboarding.

Sofia Ramirez
Head of Procurement
Aurora Labs
DocuSign: envelope 0x9a7b signed by Aurora Procurement pending Redwood signature
